summary: RenX Enterprises Corp. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an Exchange Agreement on June 11, 2026 with related-party debtholder Index Equity US, LLC to exchange $7.17M in outstanding principal and accrued interest under a promissory note for 7,169 shares of newly designated Series C Convertible Preferred Stock and a warrant to buy 619,084 common shares. The Preferred Stock converts at an initial price of $2.895/share into 2.48M common shares, subject to full-ratchet anti-dilution and a floor price of $1.50. The transaction effectively converts debt to equity, canceling the note. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for Nasdaq shareholder approval requirements and potential dilution impact on existing holders.
